verdict.rationale: Recurly's developer API page lists official client libraries for Ruby, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, PHP and Go. It also documents native Android/iOS mobile SDKs and a JavaScript SDK for Recurly Engage, and community threads discuss Recurly.js as a first-party client library. missing for 10: in-depth SDK documentation evidence (installation, versioning, maintenance cadence), independent hands-on corroboration of the server-side SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
